title: Microsoft Viva Engage: Minimum operating system requirements changing for iOS and iPadOS
summary: Starting January 2027, Microsoft Viva Engage app updates for iOS and iPadOS will require version 18 or later. Devices on iOS/iPadOS 17 or earlier can keep using current app versions but won't get updates or new features. No admin action needed; users should update their OS to continue receiving updates.
body:
[What and why]

As announced in MC1556088, we are ending support for new releases of the Teams mobile app on iOS and iPadOS 17. Following this change, we are also updating the minimum operating system requirements for new releases of the Microsoft Viva Engage app for iOS and iPadOS.

Beginning in early January 2027, new app releases will require iOS or iPadOS 18 or later. Devices running iOS or iPadOS 17 or earlier can continue using their current version of the Viva Engage app but will no longer receive app updates or new features.

[Rollout schedule]

- General Availability (Worldwide): Rollout will begin in early January 2027 and is expected to complete by early January 2027.[Impact on your organization]

Who is affected

- Users of the standalone Microsoft Viva Engage app on devices running iOS or iPadOS 17 or earlier.Platforms and services

- Microsoft Viva Engage for iOS and iPadOSWhat will happen

- Beginning in January 2027, new releases of the Viva Engage app will require iOS or iPadOS 18 or later. Devices running iOS or iPadOS 18 or later are not affected by this change.- Devices running iOS or iPadOS 17 or earlier can continue using their currently installed version of the Viva Engage app but will no longer receive app updates or new features.- Viva Engage in Microsoft Teams will follow the operating system requirements of the Teams mobile app.[Action required and recommendations]

No administrator action is required; this change will happen automatically. We recommend that you:

- Notify affected users running iOS or iPadOS 17 or earlier to update their operating system to iOS or iPadOS 18 or later to continue receiving Viva Engage app updates.- Update relevant internal documentation as appropriate.
bodyHtml:
[What and why]

As announced in MC1556088, we are ending support for new releases of the Teams mobile app on iOS and iPadOS 17. Following this change, we are also updating the minimum operating system requirements for new releases of the Microsoft Viva Engage app for iOS and iPadOS.

Beginning in early January 2027, new app releases will require iOS or iPadOS 18 or later. Devices running iOS or iPadOS 17 or earlier can continue using their current version of the Viva Engage app but will no longer receive app updates or new features.

[Rollout schedule]

  • General Availability (Worldwide): Rollout will begin in early January 2027 and is expected to complete by early January 2027.

[Impact on your organization]

Who is affected

  • Users of the standalone Microsoft Viva Engage app on devices running iOS or iPadOS 17 or earlier.

Platforms and services

  • Microsoft Viva Engage for iOS and iPadOS

What will happen

  • Beginning in January 2027, new releases of the Viva Engage app will require iOS or iPadOS 18 or later. Devices running iOS or iPadOS 18 or later are not affected by this change.
  • Devices running iOS or iPadOS 17 or earlier can continue using their currently installed version of the Viva Engage app but will no longer receive app updates or new features.
  • Viva Engage in Microsoft Teams will follow the operating system requirements of the Teams mobile app.

[Action required and recommendations]

No administrator action is required; this change will happen automatically. We recommend that you:

  • Notify affected users running iOS or iPadOS 17 or earlier to update their operating system to iOS or iPadOS 18 or later to continue receiving Viva Engage app updates.
  • Update relevant internal documentation as appropriate.
